title: Passkey (WebAuthn) login

requirements.text: The server issues registration options and verifies the attestation response (challenge, origin, RP ID), storing credential id, public key and sign count for the user
The server verifies the assertion signature against the stored key with challenge, origin, RP ID and user-verification checks
Challenges are stored server-side, expire and are consumed once
A sign-count regression is rejected or flagged as a possible cloned authenticator
Credential ids are unique across accounts; users list and remove only their own passkeys and cannot remove their last sign-in method
Successful authentication creates a fresh session (no session fixation)

implementations.notes: Wraps maintained WebAuthn libraries; recorded-ceremony tests run only in examples/cookbook per-language suites, not in tests/

notes: Challenge storage, credential management and session creation are app work. language-modules tests cover installing the Python wrapper, not its behavior.
